notes.title: 0.8.4 - Trinity Update
notes.notes:
Oh baby a triple! This update has three parts to it, mostly cuz of poor planning on my part. I hate planning!
First, its an april fools update with some content i guess.
Second, its a big teaser to 0.9! (totally not because I didn't finish all the content)
Third, its the full release of modding!
Heres the changelog:

 New bosses: Puchan mage and Intrinity
 New progression: Riftinator! No new actual stuff cuz its still a teaser
 New enemies! Even some new passive enemies!
 Treasure to dig up and get money I guess!
 New music! Slimeboss and Wyrm have songs now, and so does Intrinity. Thanks to Keytiri from Pixabay and OneManSymphony from Bandcamp for the songs (they were paid by the way)!
 New weapons: Atomiser, Lobotomiser, Krafrarmbrust to complete the virsteel tier of weapons
 Stack merging in inventory I think
 Hold shift to craft all items that you can in the crafting menu!
 New icons for a ton of items
 Some rebalancing for some weapons (i think ranged is still op af though)
 Some earlygame magic weapons and items I guess!
 A secret...
 More money dropped from bosses
 Three new achievements
 Both revolver weapons don't deal headshots anymore, instead you can do a cointoss and ricochet your bullet to deal headshots!
 Mannequin now gets cumulative damage, so its readings for the shotgun and stuff are accurate
 Boomstick, Tactical Shotgun and Laserbuss knockback have been nerfed
 Recoil on harder difficulties have been nerfed
 Enemy spawnrate on harder difficulties has been nerfed
 Fixed gorlex's speedrun challenge
 There is now a shield slot, allowing you to use shields alongside melee weapons. Perfect parrying has also been buffed to give a new effect
 New dialogue system
 New character customisation option
 Added effects to enemies, now they can be set on fire by a few weapons
 Added more tutorials and hints, which can be disabled!

Changes from the beta


 Fixed range weapons using the wrong loading setting
And probably more that I forgot


Upcoming: quests, events, more progression, better weapons, and more

Thanks for tuning in! Sorry for the wait lol. Out!

notes.title: 'Update 0.8.2: Guns and Glory' Out now!
notes.notes:
Ugmania Update 0.8.2 is now out of beta, with less gamebreaking bugs than ever! In celebration, the game is now on sale for a week!

 Many new weapons, all of them expanding the ranged class! These come in the form of guns, crossbows, shotguns, and even laser guns!!!
 3 new armour sets to buff ranged weapon users
 Added a new boss: Biohazardous Behemoth. This massive slime can be summoned on Wasteland planets, and is an alternative to Wyrm.
 Fixed save file loading: any errors will not stop the rest of the save file loading
 Updated the version text
 Revamped some world generation to make it more extreme and hilly to make it more interesting
 Changed caves completely, they are now one large cave, and have new features inside.
 Fixed crashing when enemies try to fire at you at point blank range
 Buffed several melee weapons
 Nerfed Crystal tiara+aurum armour loadout damage boosts
 Made Infernal armour give more damage boost to melee
 Reworked the Flameberge, now charges up in day and does tons of damage.
 Made snowman snipers finally drop their sniper rifle!!!
 New lore expanding on the Ugs
 Made it more obvious that villagers brains get boosted upon beating Wyrm
 Changed enemy spawning to be less unpredictable and more wave based!
 Fixed lore appearing multiple times when opening and closing the menu
 Fixed lore not being readable
 Made some potions longer, such as the radiation immunity, fire immunity, and defense potions
 Made wormhole ejectors NOT break your save file
 Made wormhole ejectors update all other wormhole chests when they eject

There have also been some changes made to new stuff from the last beta:

 Slimeboss nerfed slightly
 Multishot reforge nerfed a lot
 Preservative doesn't spawn ammo in the ground and whatever

Cheers!

notes.title: UGMANIA 0.8: THE STEAM RELEASE
notes.notes:
Its been a long journey, but its finally here! UGMANIA IS ON STEAM!!!
The legacy 0.7.2 version is still available on itch.io, and it will stay that way. 
NEW ADDITIONS IN 0.8!!!

 4 new bosses! 
 New classes (although they are barebones at the moment): Ranger and Mage!
 ADDED CHESTS!!! GONE ARE THE DAYS OF LAGGY ITEMS STREWN EVERYWHERE!!! Including shared inventory chests as well!
 New progression (thats what 2 of those bosses are). The Compoundry, the best crafting station as of yet, now needs a boss to be beaten.
 Modifiers! When crafted, a weapon (or tool) has a chance to get a modifier! You can change these modifiers at a certain villager, but it will cost you...
 Effects! You can now get status effects like Burning, Deafened or Poisoned! There are also positive effects, which leads us onto our next point...
 Brewing! You can now create drinkable potions to give yourself benefits!
 Radiation! A gimmick on Wasteland planets. Staying on one of these planets for too long (or just touching the water a bit too much) will cause you to start taking damage! You could use a potion to be more resistant to it...
 A starting cutscene and tutorial! 
 Mana! All staffs are now part of the mage class and consequently use mana.
 Many new items!
 Achievements!
 Made the sun and moon not tied to each other, they move independently. This makes for more interesting skies. 
 Added more settings, and revamped the UI.
 Changed save files a ton, they are encrypted now and are stored in a folder thats created in documents by default. You can configure where this folder is.
 Made the play time in HMS instead of decimal hours (this took longer than it should have)
 Cheats are disabled, and enabling them in the play menu will disable achievements. (All old save files count as cheated)
 Probably more that I forgot.

Thanks for playing!
